polls.notes: Sports-betting add-on to Siena's Q2 2026 consumer sentiment survey of NYS residents (not the SNY political series). Only the two opinion questions touching state policy are recorded; Q1-Q6 (personal betting behavior) and Q8 (whether betting commentary in broadcasts is good for sports) omitted. In this crosstab the NYC column is the 8th figure (after Total, M, F, 18-34, 35-49, 50-64, 65+). Quotes are crosstab rows with spaces collapsed. Release describes Q7 as '44% in favor and 43% opposed' of allowing ads, i.e. Total Disagree 44 / Total Agree 43 with the statement opposing ads. Release PDF: https://sri.siena.edu/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/ICS-Q2-2026-Sports-Betting-Release.pdf.
